title: `except Exception: return` in `_obj_make_compatible` silently suppresses all errors
detail: Line 401 catches `Exception` and immediately returns, with no logging or error signalling. The code is trying to fetch a compute node to embed in a versioned service object. If this fails for any reason (network error, programming bug, missing attribute) the failure is silently swallowed and the object is returned without the compute_node field — which may cause subtle downstream failures. Suggested fix: at minimum, add a `LOG.warning(...)` call; ideally catch only the specific `ComputeNodeNotFound` or RPC exceptions that are genuinely benign.
